questions.question: Born on this day in 1967, Steven Wilson is the founder, guitarist, and lead singer of which progressive rock band?
questions.explanation: English musician Steven Wilson created the progressive rock group Porcupine Tree, serving as its primary songwriter, singer, and guitarist.
questions.context:
On this day in 1967: Steven Wilson, English singer-songwriter, guitarist, and producer
Steven Wilson (English musician (born 1967)): Steven John Wilson is an English musician, composer and multi-instrumentalist. He is the founder, guitarist, lead vocalist, and songwriter of the progressive rock band Porcupine Tree, as well as being a member of several other bands, including Blackfield, Storm Corrosion and No-Man.

questions.question: Inde Navarrette achieved widespread recognition and awards for starring in which 2025 supernatural horror film?
questions.explanation: Inde Navarrette gained global fame and a Critics' Choice Award for her lead role in the 2025 supernatural horror movie Obsession.
questions.context: Inde Navarrette (American actress (born 2001)): Danielle Fabiola "Inde" Navarrette is an American actress. She began acting in short films as a teenager before landing roles in the drama series 13 Reasons Why (2020) and the superhero series Superman & Lois (2021–2024). Navarrette achieved global stardom for headlining the supernatural horror film Obsession (2025), winning several accolades, including a Critics' Choice Award. She will also portray Rogue in the untitled X-Men film (2028) set in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

questions.question: On which traditional dates in November is the Mexican holiday Day of the Dead primarily celebrated?
questions.explanation: Day of the Dead is traditionally observed on 1 and 2 November as families gather to honour and remember deceased relatives.
questions.context: Day of the Dead (Mexican multi-day holiday): The Day of the Dead is a holiday traditionally celebrated on November 1 and 2, though other days, such as October 31 or November 6, may be included depending on the locality. The multi-day holiday involves family and friends gathering to pay respects and remember friends and family members who have died. The celebrations can take a humorous tone, as celebrants remember amusing events and anecdotes about the departed.

questions.question: What substance has historically been spread across the ocean surface by mariners to reduce wave strength and assist in maritime rescues?
questions.explanation: Storm oil acts as a surfactant on ocean water, flattening heavy waves to make navigation safer and aid sea rescues.
questions.context: Storm oil (Oil spread from ships to calm waves): Storm oil is described as nearly water-insoluble oil acting as a surfactant, and has been used since ancient times to smooth ocean waves. It has been historically employed to facilitate sea rescues and improve navigational safety, involving pouring the oil onto the ocean surface to reduce wave intensity.

questions.question: Which Mercedes driver became the youngest-ever Formula One World Drivers' Champion after winning the title in 2026?
questions.explanation: Italian driver Kimi Antonelli secured the 2026 Formula One World Drivers' Championship while driving for Mercedes, making him the youngest driver in history to win the title.
questions.context: Kimi Antonelli (Italian racing driver (born 2006)): Andrea Kimi Antonelli is an Italian racing driver who competes in Formula One for Mercedes. Antonelli won the Formula One World Drivers' Championship in 2026 with Mercedes, becoming the youngest-ever World Drivers' Champion; he has won nine Grands Prix since his debut in 2025.
